description: Defines the DataGroupPermissionFilterParams class used for filtering data group permissions in the OrangeHRM system, including properties for user roles, data groups, and access controls.

classes.name: DataGroupPermissionFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for specifying parameters to filter data group permissions based on roles, entities, and access levels.

methods.name: getUserRoles
methods.description: Returns the array of UserRole objects associated with the filter parameters.

methods.name: setUserRoles
methods.description: Sets the array of UserRole objects for the filter parameters.

methods.name: isWithApiDataGroups
methods.description: Checks if API data groups are included in the filter.

methods.name: setWithApiDataGroups
methods.description: Sets whether to include API data groups in the filter.

methods.name: isOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Determines if only accessible permissions are considered.

methods.name: setOnlyAccessible
methods.description: Sets whether to consider only accessible permissions.

methods.name: getRolesToExclude
methods.description: Returns roles to exclude from the filter.

methods.name: setRolesToExclude
methods.description: Sets roles to exclude from the filter.

methods.name: getRolesToInclude
methods.description: Returns roles to include in the filter.

methods.name: setRolesToInclude
methods.description: Sets roles to include in the filter.

methods.name: getEntities
methods.description: Returns the list of entity identifiers involved in the filter.

methods.name: setEntities
methods.description: Sets the list of entity identifiers for the filter.

methods.name: getDataGroups
methods.description: Returns the data groups involved in the filter.

methods.name: setDataGroups
methods.description: Sets the data groups for the filter.

methods.name: isSelfPermissions
methods.description: Checks if self permissions are enabled.

methods.name: setSelfPermissions
methods.description: Sets whether self permissions are enabled.
